description: BreizhCrops is the Python benchmark package published by the DL4SITS research team for crop classification from satellite time series. It loads regional data partitions and exposes training and prediction workflows for models including transformers, temporal convolutional networks and recurrent neural networks. Inputs are the separately retrieved BreizhCrops sequences and crop labels; outputs include predicted crop classes and evaluation results. Its examples use Brittany, France, with the FRH04 partition for evaluation and labels derived from the French Registre parcellaire graphique. Public software is free under GPL-3.0. A limitation is that the README does not establish a uniform licence or temporal coverage for every external data file, and some installation examples pin older dependencies. The software can calibrate crop-map components used in irrigation and food-supply simulations alongside CY-Bench (data-cy-bench-subnational-crop-yield-benchmark). The repository includes working loader and training examples and cites its 2020 ISPRS paper. This record covers the documented software; it does not assign GPL terms to external imagery. No benchmark data or weights were downloaded.
name: BreizhCrops time-series benchmark software
